title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Principle 04 ]

blocks.text: Finally, I’d like/love to tell you about my relatives.
I have many relatives because both of my parents have many brothers and sisters.
My father has (2) brothers and (2) sisters, while my mother has (3) brothers and (3) sisters.
My father is the oldest in his family, while my mother is the second child in her family.
Most my aunts and uncles are married.
I have a total of (6) cousins: (3) from my father’s side and (3) from my mother's side of the family.
I have many favorite relatives, but my oldest uncle (홍길동) on my mother’s side is my most favorite one.
Uncle (홍) lives on the other side of town, and my family visits him twice a month.
When we get together we usually go out for dinner.
My oldest uncle has many talents and he is very generous.
Uncle (홍) can play all kinds of sports, and he can play the piano and guitar pretty well.
He can speak English very fluently.
He’s almost like a native speaker.
I really look up to and admire him a lot.
